plain.text: The LORD told Noah to go into the ark with his whole family, because he had found Noah righteous. He was to take seven pairs of every clean animal and bird and one pair of the others. In seven days God would send rain for forty days and forty nights. Noah did all that the LORD commanded. When Noah was 600 years old, the springs of the great deep burst open and the floodgates of the heavens opened. Noah, his family and the animals went into the ark, as God had commanded. Then the LORD shut them in. The rain fell for forty days and forty nights. The waters rose and lifted the ark high above the earth. They covered even the highest mountains. Every living thing on the earth died: people, animals, creeping things and birds. Only Noah and those with him in the ark were left. The waters flooded the earth for 150 days.

summary.bigIdea: The flood comes, but God shuts Noah, his family and the animals safely inside the ark.
points: Noah obeys and brings his family and the animals into the ark.
The LORD himself shuts them in.
The waters cover the earth, and only those in the ark survive.
summary.reflection: "The LORD shut them in." When have you felt God keeping you safe in a storm?
